definitions.gloss: personal matter; private affair; private business
definitions.explanation: Something that belongs to one's private life rather than work or public affairs. Often used as a polite preface when bringing up personal topics in a professional or formal setting.

examples.japanese: {私事|しじ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{恐縮|きょうしゅく}→恐縮：07596_kyoushuku⟧です⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧。
examples.english: I'm sorry to bring up a personal matter, but...

examples.japanese: {私事|しじ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ございます→ございます：01300_gozaimasu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{度|たび}→度：03431_tabi⟧⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦いたしました→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: On a personal note, I recently got married.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{私事|しじ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦きちんと→きちんと：00222_kichinto⟧⟦{分|わ}ける→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧べきだ。
examples.english: One should properly separate work and personal matters.

notes:
Composed of {私|し} (private/personal) + {事|じ} (matter/affair). A formal word used especially in business and professional settings when introducing personal topics.

PRONUNCIATION:
Also sometimes read as わたくしごと, which sounds even more formal and humble.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {私事|しじ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{恐縮|きょうしゅく}→恐縮：07596_kyoushuku⟧です⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧: I'm sorry to mention something personal, but...
- {私事|しじ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ございます→ございます：01300_gozaimasu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧: on a personal note (very polite)
- {私事|しじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{優先|ゆうせん}→優先：15243_yuusen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to prioritize personal matters

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{個人的|こじんてき}→個人的：04788_kojinteki⟧なこと: personal thing — more casual, everyday usage
- ⟦{公私|こうし}→公私：21213_koushi⟧: public and private (matters) — used for the contrast between work and personal life
- ⟦{私用|しよう}→私用：00459_shiyou⟧: personal use/business — focuses on activities done for personal reasons
